---
title: "A page image gets its own measured size, not the site's"
image: page.png
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/page.png">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="160">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="210">'
        - []
---

The site declares a size for its own image; this page's PNG is measured instead.
